scope: Fresh isolated Chrome; synthetic 10-stock / 2-fund database; real local refresh pipeline with HTTP/AI stubs, cached official documents, all external traffic blocked. No real user database, native installation or live services.

checks.name: actual Check today button completes all 12 stock/fund plans without AI, without settings redirect or business writes
manual pause, failed principles, historical quotes, original document dates and unverified execution session remain separate
320/390px and 1x/1.3x font show usable compact rows, cancellation/retry controls and no horizontal overflow
a row navigates to its actual original plan evidence without writing a price or pause
optional AI HTTP failure retains local explanation and the complete deterministic list without machine actions
one bad stock does not block other items; partial results and last completed batch are kept separately
actual per-item Retry requests only the selected failed stock and retains every other result and check time
cross-day UI Retry checks only the selected item; 11 old times and historical sources remain visible, today count is 1/12, and explanation is disabled
Cancel aborts the quote-stage batch; releasing late HTTP replies cannot change business data or replace its cancelled result
the real UI reaches a timeout with the same pipeline and an injected shorter test deadline; no later stages start
a plan/holding edit during the announcement stage cancels stale writes and preserves the user’s new values
all HTTP sources failing still return every deterministic item with historical prices, original dates and explicit source gaps
leaving the page cancels the batch and reopening restores its partial/cancelled result alongside the last completion
legacy advice remains readable, explicitly historical, without becoming a current check or changing the backup schema
two independent runners sharing browser IndexedDB and identical millisecond starts keep the newer current/completed batch after the old initial read arrives
